bodyHtml:
Limited-time New Year Special • Ends January 31, 2026

Start the New Year Right — Schedule Your FREE Consultation

Don’t wait for “later.” The best time to take control is now — and a quick consultation can help you map out
the smartest path forward based on your goals, health history, and budget.

Request My Free Consultation
Call (877) 442-2263

One team. Every option.

Many online programs focus on just one approach. JourneyLite is different: we offer the treatments people look for on sites like Hers.com and we also provide surgical weight loss and gastric balloon options — all under one roof.

  • Medical weight loss (including GLP-1 programs when appropriate)
  • Non-surgical options like gastric balloon
  • Surgical options for long-term, durable results
  • Real medical oversight from an experienced bariatric team including Licensed/Registered Dietitians

What you’ll get in your free consult

  • An in-person or virtual consultation with an experienced medical provider
  • An in-person or virtual consultation with a Licensed/Registered Dietitian
  • A clear recommendation on the best next step
  • Answers to your questions — no pressure, no obligation
  • A realistic timeline to start strong in 2026
  • Next-step planning (insurance/self-pay/financing pathways if needed)

Claim the New Year Free Consultation →

Special ends January 31, 2026. Appointments fill fast in January.

Don’t start the year behind.

If you’ve been thinking about weight loss for months (or years), make this the moment you take the first step.
Schedule now and let’s build your plan.

Schedule My Free Consultation
